caption: The drawing features two large blue floral motifs, each composed of a pair of rounded petals or leaves with additional smaller appendages, rendered in a watercolor or wash technique on a grayish background. Above the motifs, there is a partial inscription in black text reading "JOHN BELL. WAYNESBORO," followed by "1½" in a larger, embossed style. Each floral element is adorned with a series of smaller, circular blue dots arranged in an arc above the round shapes. In the bottom right corner of the drawing is a rectangular white insert showing a simple, outlined sketch of a cylindrical stoneware jar with two side handles; the same blue floral motif from the main field is depicted as decoration on the upper portion of the jar. The image is framed by a beige border, which is slightly darker than the central gray, and the name "F. Tumagalli" is signed at the bottom left of the border.
title: Jar
